As a professional senior software engineer based in Hangzhou, I bring over five years of industry experience to the table.

My expertise lies in **NextJs**, **React**, **Spring**, and **Clean Architecture with .NET**, which I've honed through dedicated practice and real-world projects.

Specializing in crafting robust, practical, and sustainable software solutions across diverse platforms, I continuously refine my skills to deliver top-tier services adhering to industry best practices.
